content.text: {"summary":"Weatherbot's engine moved simulated Miami-Dade up to level 5, Hurricane Warning, from Warning / Watch / Evacuation (level 4). A Hurricane Warning now covers the location, replacing the earlier Hurricane Watch [S1][S2]. Storm Demo advisory 8 was issued, and the location is in its cone [S2]. Actions: shelter if not evacuated; expect outages; follow local orders. Follow the instructions of your local officials.","sources":["S1","S2"]}
